recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless CQI explicitly wants the operation parameter text to redundantly restate the pending-status polling behavior despite the active Quality Reporting guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-16853 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request from STU3 asking that $evaluate-measure support returning a reference to where a MeasureReport is stored; the accepted resolution was to document that the operation result may have status Pending while the report is still being generated.
initial_application: Jira records SVN 14856, and git commit a4108a4527ee7c42c72d30079f4db07690281cfd ("GF#16853: Clarify asynchronous behavior of MeasureReport") added Quality Reporting prose saying implementations may return a MeasureReport with status pending and clients can poll until it becomes complete.
additional_context: The current $evaluate-measure return shape has changed since STU3: FHIR-37988 moved results from a single MeasureReport to Bundles containing MeasureReports, and FHIR-51487 later corrected return documentation to focus on Bundle structure and link to the Quality Reporting guidance. FHIR-55082 later clarified MeasureReport.status, including pending and error semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html still says implementations may return a pending MeasureReport while evaluation is in progress, and MeasureReport.status still includes and defines pending. Re-adding the pending sentence to the operation parameter would duplicate existing guidance after later return-documentation cleanup.

related_jiras.note: Changed $evaluate-measure output from a single MeasureReport to Bundle results while preserving MeasureReport-as-result semantics in a new return shape.
Corrected current $evaluate and $evaluate-measure return documentation to describe Bundle structure and point to Quality Reporting guidance rather than duplicating all MeasureReport behavior.
Clarified MeasureReport.status by defining pending as in-progress and adding an error escape valve.
